import Mathlib

theorem p07 (n : ℕ) (h : 3 ≤ n) : 2 * n < 2 ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  induction k with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [Nat.add_succ, pow_succ]
      nlinarith
